registered_at: 2026-09-17 (v2 position-controlled gap arms, registered before running; v0/v1 unchanged)
status: registered before execution; diagnostic, not confirmatory
question: Does frozen OlmoEarth v1 base (patch 4, 40 m tokens) change its readout decisions under (a) sub-token spatial grid offsets of 20 m and (b) month-label perturbations of identical pixels?
model: OlmoEarth v1 base via rslearn wrapper, token_pooling, patch 4, real acquisition dates from sealed contract (same as sealed P4 cache)
readout: resolution_contract_v2/p4_native_control/<fold>_seed1_best.pt, frozen; normalisation stats recomputed from the unperturbed train cache exactly as in training

ctrl.role: control; also reproducibility check against sealed cache (expect token cos >= .995)

s40_xy.role: full-token shift; positive control for the alignment machinery (tokens should re-align by one cell)

t_synth.role: same month index, synthetic day/year (what extract_olmo_variants used)

t_plus1.role: every timestamp moved +1 calendar month; pixels unchanged

t_shuffle.role: month labels permuted per tile (seeded); pixels and order unchanged

y_plus1.role: every timestamp +1 year, month/day kept; tests whether year matters (model encodes month only)

gap_r3.role: 3 of 12 timesteps removed at random (seeded per tile)

cloud1.role: clearest kept timestep replaced by the cloudiest dropped one (NetCDF)

cloud3.role: 3 clearest replaced by the 3 cloudiest dropped

hole_pre3.role: 3 consecutive removed entirely before the first post-event image

hole_post3.role: 3 consecutive removed starting at the first post-event image

hole_span3.role: 3 consecutive centred on the pre/post boundary

hole_late3.role: last 3 of the window removed (streaming-like end gap)

spatial_handling: tile viewed at (dy,dx) with 4-px edge replication on the far side; prediction map shifted back to the original frame; all metrics on the common window rows/cols 8..120 (2-token border excluded)

metrics.primary_label_free: decision_flip_rate = fraction of window pixels whose 0.5-threshold decision differs from ctrl
secondary_label_free: token_cos vs ctrl on aligned arms (time arms and s40_xy shifted by one cell)
metrics.labelled: positive_patch_macro_iou in the window vs ctrl

decision_rules.yardstick: s40_xy decision_flip_rate (full-token shift) is the harmless-perturbation floor
decision_rules.spatial_axis_present: mean decision_flip_rate over s20_* arms >= 2 x s40_xy flip rate AND >= 0.02 absolute, in both folds
decision_rules.time_axis_present: decision_flip_rate of t_plus1 or t_shuffle >= 2 x s40_xy flip rate AND >= 0.02 absolute, in both folds
decision_rules.time_axis_inert: all time arms flip rate < 0.005 and token_cos > .995 -> month encoding is effectively ignored at this contract; continuous-time post-training track closed for Sen12
decision_rules.control_failure: ctrl vs sealed token_cos < .99 -> extraction not reproducible; stop and audit before interpreting anything

not_claimed: cause of instability (aliasing vs boundary vs normalisation) is not separated here
no generalisation beyond Sen12 S2 10-band contract
compute: GPU0 only; ~1435 tiles x 8 arms at ~6.5 tiles/s ~ 30 min; no sealed file modified
question_v1: Do frozen OlmoEarth decisions change under deployment-realistic temporal perturbations: missing timesteps (gaps), cloud-contaminated observations, and calendar-year shift?

decision_rules_v1.axis_present_generic: arm flip rate >= 2 x yardstick AND >= 0.02 absolute in both folds
decision_rules_v1.note: gap/cloud arms change the information content, not only its encoding; a drop there is expected to some degree. The registered question is whether the drop is large relative to the tolerated s40 floor and whether it is graceful (gap_r3 < gap_r6, cloud1 < cloud3).

dup_month_probe: separate 2-tile probe: does the wrapper accept two observations in the same calendar month with different days? Recorded as accept/reject; no metric.
question_v2: With the same hole size (3 consecutive of 12), does the loss depend on WHERE the hole sits relative to the landslide event? pre-event-only hole vs hole starting at the first post-event image vs hole spanning the boundary vs hole at the window end.

decision_rules_v2.analysis_set: positive tiles with post_index and first_post_slot in [3, 9] (no fallback); fallback tiles excluded from the v2 comparison
decision_rules_v2.information_explanation_supported: hole_pre3 mean dIoU within +-0.02 of ctrl AND hole_post3 loss >= 3x |hole_pre3| in both folds -> loss is removal of post-event evidence, not a model fragility; time-axis post-training motivation closed on Sen12
decision_rules_v2.structure_explanation_supported: hole_pre3 loss <= -0.05 in both folds (pre-event hole hurts although no evidence removed) -> temporal-structure fragility; register a readout-retrained control next
